cands.bio: Optometrist and Republican state representative for Alabama House District 100 since November 2022. He co-operates an optometry practice in West Mobile and is a former president of the Alabama Optometric Association. He lost the 2018 Republican primary for State Senate District 34.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Shirey grew up or the exact year he moved to Mobile. We found no record of bills he sponsored or actions he took in office on data centers, homestead property taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, police, guns, abortion or schools. We found no statements from him on those topics either. His campaign site lists only general themes: a conservative voice for Mobile, attention to the coast, and small-business protection. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate surveys in 2022 or 2026. We found no documented controversies, foreign ties, endorsements, or statements on data centers or development.

qual.background: Alabama House member since 2022; optometrist who has run a small-business optometry practice in Mobile for about 20 years; past president of the Alabama Optometric Association, where he says he helped write legislation on eye-care access.
qual.why: He has prior legislative service, which puts him in the high band, and he has managed a business. His career is in health care rather than law, policy or budgeting, so the score is held at the lower end of that band.
